title: FIFA World Cup Celebrations Turn Fatal in Mexico
summary: Three people died in Mexico City due to suffocation while celebrating Mexico's advancement in the FIFA World Cup 2026. The incident occurred as fans crowded the streets after the team defeated Ecuador, ending a 40-year wait for a World Cup knockout victory.
summary_points: A fatal incident occurred in Mexico City during celebrations of Mexico's FIFA World Cup 2026 advancement
Three people died due to suffocation while celebrating in the city
The incident happened after Mexico defeated Ecuador, ending a 40-year wait for a World Cup knockout victory
Crowded streets and celebrations may have contributed to the fatal outcome
Authorities are investigating the cause of the deaths
